items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 4 ACs implemented (ModalShell flex-column height cap, TriageDetailModal flex-wrap action row, PerProjectTriageSection/DeferredTriageSection max-md: margin tightening, TriageFilterSortBar phone collapse via useIsPhoneViewport); nothing beyond spec scope was added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure client-side layout/CSS change; no new API calls, error boundaries, or data-boundary code introduced.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no SQL/HTML injection surface, no secrets, no auth/permission surface touched — CSS classes and one boolean UI-state toggle only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 63 unit assertions across 5 test files assert on rendered className/attributes (outcomes, not internals), plus 7 real-browser Playwright E2E cases (mobile-triage-form-layout.spec.ts) proving actual geometry per AC; both happy-path and the historically-fragile More-Options path are covered.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops of network/DB calls, no unbounded list rendering, no new synchronous blocking — one extra useState + a media-query hook already used elsewhere in the codebase.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All touched files stay under the 300-line convention; new classes/testids follow existing MoreOptionsDisclosure-style naming (triage-filter-sort-toggle, aria-expanded) and Tailwind max-md: idiom introduced consistently across all 4 touched components.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format (JSON/JSONL/schema) changed or introduced by this diff — CSS/layout and one client-only UI toggle only.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings against the changed test files.
